title: T101 (Tinyana) PNC - Tikkun Chatzois and Tehillim as Hisbodedus — Find Yourself in Every Pasuk
hebrewTitle: תיקון חצות ואמירת תהלים כהתבודדות — "קוה אל ה' חזק ויאמץ לבך"
author: Pettek Nanach

beginner.en: **Amar she-al-yedei amiras Tikkun Chatzois yecholin le-fareish sichaso es kol asher im levavoi kemo al-yedei hisbodedus.** Saying *Tikkun Chatzois* can be a complete hisbodedus — *if* one says it in the right register. **Ki mistama ein oimrim chatzois al he-avar** — one does not say Chatzois only about *the distant past* of churban Yerushalayim; *ve-ikar amiras chatzois hu al mah she-na'asah achshav im ha-adam*. **Ve-ke-she-yomar chatzois bi-bechinah zo, yecholin limtzo kol asher im levavoi be-toich amiras chatzois.** The bechinas churban that is *yours, right now, today* — find it inside the words of Tikkun Chatzois, and the *fixed* nusach becomes your *private* hisbodedus.

intermediate.en: **Tikkun Chatzois ke-hisbodedus**: *ein oimrim chatzois al he-avar bilvad — ikkar amiras chatzois al mah she-na'aseh achshav*. K'she-yomar bi-bechinah zo → *limtzo kol asher im levavoi be-toich ha-nusach*.

scholarly.he: [T2:101א] תיקון חצות = פירוש שיחה ככל אשר בלבבו; עיקרו על מה שנעשה עכשיו עם האדם, לא על העבר בלבד.

beginner.en: **Find yourself in every Tehillim, every techinah, every selichah.** *Ve-chein amiras Tehillim ve-cha-yoitzei tzarich lir'os, she-yimtzo es atzmoi be-toich kol mizmoirei Tehillim u-vetoich kol ha-techinois u-vakashois u-slichois ve-cha-yoitzei*. **U-vekal bi-feshitus, bli chochmois, yecholin limtzo es atzmoi be-toich kol ha-techinois u-vakashois — u-vifrat be-Tehillim, she-ne'emar bi-shvil klal Yisrael, bi-shvil kol echad ve-echad bi-frat.** Tehillim was said *for klal Yisrael* — *which means for every yochid in his own pratiyus*. *Kol milchamois ha-yetzer ha-ra* she-yesh alav, *ve-chol mah she-na'aseh imoi, ha-kol mevu'ar u-mefareish be-Tehillim*. Tehillim is *not* a book of someone-else's history; *kuloi ne'emar al milchamois ha-yetzer*, *she-heim ikar ha-oivim ve-ha-soin'im shel ha-adam, she-rotzim li-mno'oi mi-derech ha-chaim u-le-hoiridoi li-sheoil tachtiyois*.

intermediate.en: **Tehillim**: *yimtzo es atzmoi be-toich kol mizmoir*. *Bekal bi-feshitus bli chochmois* — *Tehillim ne'emar bi-shvil kol echad ve-echad bi-frat*. **Kol milchamois ha-yetzer + kol mah she-na'aseh imoi = mevu'ar u-mefareish be-Tehillim**. *Tehillim = sefer milchamois ha-yetzer ha-ra ve-chayalav*.

scholarly.he: [T2:101ב] תהלים — למצוא את עצמו בכל מזמור; ספר תהלים = ספר מלחמות היצר; נאמר עבור כל יחיד בפרטיותו.

beginner.en: **The ikkar of the whole avoidah — and the chizuk that does not let go.** *Ki ikkar klal ve-shoresh ve-yesoid shel kol ha-eitzois le-his-kareiv le-HaShem yisbarach, hu rak amiras Tehillim u-she'arei techinois u-vakashois ve-hisbodedus, le-fareish sichaso beinoi le-vein konoi, le-vakeish mi-lefonav, she-yekarvehu la-avodaso yisbarach* — *rak al-yedei zeh zoichin le-natze'ach ha-milchamah*. **Ve-af-al-pi she-nimtza'im kammah eitzois toivois be-sifrei Rabbeinu** — full of eitzois — *af-al-pi-chein al pi-rov kasheh la-adam le-kayem ha-eitzah be-atzmah*. **Al kein ha-ikkar — tefillois ve-techinois u-vakashois**, *yih'yeh eich she-yih'yeh*, *al kol panim yedabber be-fiv be-eizo bechinah she-hu, ve-yevakeish me-HaShem yisbarach tomid, she-yoitzi oisoi mei-choshech le-or ve-yachzireihu bi-tshuvah sheleimah be-emes, ve-al yiten domi lo ad she-ya'aneihu*. **Berachos 32a**: *she-tefillah tzricha chizuk*, ka-kasuv (Tehillim 27:14): **"kaveh el Hashem, chazak ve-ya'ametz libecha, ve-kaveh el Hashem,"** u-feirush Rashi: *ve-im loi tiskabel tefilascha — chazor ve-kavei. Ve-chein le-olam, ad yashkif ve-yere Hashem mi-shamayim.*

intermediate.en: **Ikkar klal ha-eitzois** = tefillah, techinois, hisbodedus → *rak al-yedei zeh zoichin li-natze'ach ha-milchamah*. *Af she-yesh eitzois rabois — al pi-rov kasheh le-kayem; al kein ha-ikar tefillah, yih'yeh eich she-yih'yeh*. **ברכות לב. — "תפלה צריכה חיזוק"; תה' כז:יד "קַוֵּה אֶל ה' חֲזַק וְיַאֲמֵץ לִבֶּךָ וְקַוֵּה אֶל ה' "** ; רש"י: *im loi tiskabel — chazor ve-kavei, ve-chein le-olam ad yashkif ve-yere Hashem mi-shamayim*.

scholarly.he: [T2:101ג] עיקר העצות = תפילה ותחנות והתבודדות. ברכות לב. "תפילה צריכה חיזוק"; תה' כז:יד ורש"י — "חזור וקווה... עד ישקיף וירא ה' משמים."

beginner.en: **"Tzrichin le-chazor zos alafim pe'amim."** *Kvar mevu'ar zois bi-divareinu kammah pe'amim — ach tzrichin lichpoil u-lishnois zois u-le-zachor zos be-chol yom va-yom. Ki yesh kammah ve-chammah minei chalisheis u-bilbulim al zeh bli shi'ur, mah she-ein ha-peh yachoil le-dabber ve-ha-leiv lachshov*. The chalishus and the bilbulim on this one nekudah — *to keep crying out to HaShem yisbarach, no matter what* — are *bli shi'ur*. *Al kein tzrichin lachzor zos alafim pe'amim, kedei she-yischazek vi-yes-ametz la-amoid al amdoi, le-his-paleil u-le-his-chaneien lifnei HaShem yisbarach tomid, she-yekarvehu la-avodasoi, yih'yeh eich she-yih'yeh*. **"Nisa levaveinu el kapayim el Eil ba-shamayim. Ki loi yitoish Hashem es amoi ve-nachalaso loi ya'azoiv. Chasdei Hashem ki loi tamnu, ki loi chalu rachamav."**

intermediate.en: **Tzaroch lachzor alafim pe'amim**: *yeish bli-shi'ur chalisheis u-bilbulim* la-amoid al amdoi be-tefillah. **Chasimah**: *"נשא לבבנו אל כפים אל א-ל בשמים. כי לא יטוש ה' את עמו ונחלתו לא יעזב. חסדי ה' כי לא תמנו, כי לא כלו רחמיו."*

scholarly.he: [T2:101ד] לחזור על העצה הזאת אלפים פעמים, כי החלישות והבלבולים בלי שיעור. חתימת רבי נתן: "נשא לבבנו אל כפים אל א-ל בשמים" וגו'.
